warning_source: Ronen Bar — Shin Bet Director; Herzi Halevi — IDF Chief of Staff
warning_summary: Bar and Halevi warned that the planned Wadi Qaddum demolition in East Jerusalem could trigger escalation lasting through Ramadan.
evidence_update: Contemporaneous Arutz 7 reporting identifies the named warning chain; Times of Israel and JNS independently corroborate Netanyahu's postponement and the security concern that demolition could trigger clashes/wider violence. Published to Notion as WARN-114 at Medium confidence.
gaps: No public official transcript/written warning. Other diplomatic pressure was also reported, so do not attribute postponement solely to this warning. Not a Gaza/Oct. 7 attack warning.

warning_source: Shin Bet / senior security-system official reported by N12
warning_summary: Retrospective N12 reporting says Shin Bet informed Netanyahu on 11 occasions in Feb–Mar 2023 that a high-quality operational opportunity existed to target Yahya Sinwar.
evidence_update: Original N12 report of 28 Jan 2026 was recovered, strengthening provenance beyond derivative coverage. Netanyahu/PMO categorically disputes the account and says the opposite is documented in meeting minutes.
gaps: Need Shin Bet operational records, contemporaneous minutes, or independent corroboration of the 11 notifications and Netanyahu response before acceptance.

warning_summary: Bar's later sworn affidavit says Shin Bet warned that adversaries perceived an opportunity amid internal division and in April recommended a targeted forceful move to halt deterrence erosion.
evidence_update: Bar's sworn 2025 affidavit is authoritative retrospective evidence, but the specific April event still lacks an exact date/forum and independent contemporaneous corroboration. Netanyahu's later counter-account cites contemporaneous assessments he says pointed to Hamas restraint.
gaps: Recover April 2023 Shin Bet paper/minutes/distribution record, named recipients and contemporaneous corroboration; preserve Netanyahu's contrary account.

warning_source: Maj. Gen. Avi Gil — PM military secretary
warning_summary: A later account says Gil warned in the Aug. 21 security briefing that Iran and armed groups in Lebanon, the West Bank and Gaza perceived Israeli weakness amid internal division/readiness decline.
evidence_update: The Aug. 21 meeting and Gil's attendance are contemporaneously documented, but the substantive warning content publicly available still derives from later testimony by opposition leader Yair Lapid. Netanyahu/Likud disputes that such a Gaza-war warning was given.
gaps: Need Gil's own testimony, official briefing minutes, contemporaneous document or another non-opposition professional source before acceptance.

warning_source: Home Front Command / National Emergency Authority
warning_summary: During the Fist Punch multi-front exercise, Home Front Command and emergency leadership presented national home-front preparedness for a severe multi-front war scenario.
evidence_update: Contemporaneous reporting confirms Gallant's visit, the exercise and his public warning that the home front could face its toughest challenges in 75 years, but no distinct professional HFC/NEA warning delivered to Gallant was recovered.
gaps: Need the underlying HFC/NEA assessment, minutes or testimony identifying a professional warning and recipient; do not convert Gallant's own public statement into an inbound warning.
